rationale: Migrations 0008–0012 add the dictionary, card, revision, idempotency, generation-job, proposal, provider-circuit, and provider-budget structures without removing an older application contract. Migrations 0013–0016 add batch/document/import state and replace validated CHECK constraints and claim indexes on feature-owned tables. Migration 0017 adds bounded operational-observation indexes. Migration 0018 adds nullable accepted-card identity and duplicate-warning fields for cardless authoring jobs and replaces the proposal payload-state CHECK without removing columns or older accepted shapes. These constraint/index changes take table locks and can scan existing dictionary-job rows, so rollout must apply them before the new format is activated and retain the documented migration timeout and blue/green gate. Old application slots ignore the nullable columns and remain compatible. The resulting schema is therefore expand-compatible, while later contract cleanup still requires a separate drained release.
